requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Arena project racial identity pilot, ONLY ONE MALE individual of race argonian, shown THREE TIMES in a horizontal3-column ONE-row model card: LEFT=portrait bust; CENTER=exploration full body front looking down-screen in project's upper-oblique2D camera; RIGHT=full body combat guarded pose facing image LEFT. Three equal cells, no internal grid or labels. No female, no variants, no other poses. Transparent RGBA.
REFERENCES: Image1 is current portrait/individual to revise; Image2 is existing body card, retain ONLY male clothes/body proportions/front and combat-left poses. Image3 is actual Skyrim preset compilation for race-specific craniofacial anatomy, not an animal photo. Image4 is portrait POSE only. Image5 is project STYLE only. Preserve dark fantasy finish, muted palette and Arena clothes. NO Skyrim armor/accessories, no jewelry, warpaint, scars, new customization options, tails or weapons.
DIAGNOSIS TO CORRECT: Current looks like a friendly generic smooth lizard head with uniformly tiny scales, large round eye, bulbous round snout and leaf-like mane. Rebuild a Skyrim-recognizable ARGONIAN adult male head: flatter angular cranial wedge, prominent segmented brow ridge with deep-set narrow reptilian yellow eye and vertical slit pupil, broad blunt scaled muzzle with angular nostril/cheek/jaw planes rather than round pet-lizard nose; DISTINCT LARGER asymmetric polygonal head plates over smaller neck scales, light vertically segmented throat scutes. TWO small restrained backward swept bony horn/spine nubs at rear crown like modest presets, not giant dragon horns; low short muted green reptilian ridge, NOT leaf/hair/feather mane. Keep Arena/project BLUE-GRAY scales and brown shirt; do not switch whole character to Skyrim green. Masculine broad jaw and sturdy neck, natural humanoid adult proportions. Not crocodile/iguana/dragon/animal head pasted to human.
PORTRAIT ONLY mandatory block:
Retrato de busto em três quartos. O personagem inteiro está orientado para a direita da imagem: peito, ombros, pescoço, cabeça e olhar seguem a mesma orientação, com alinhamento anatômico natural. Cabeça não está virada sobre o ombro. Sem tronco voltado à esquerda, sem contrarrotação, sem pescoço torcido. Seguir a referência de pose fornecida, preservando a identidade racial e o estilo aprovado.
Portrait head AND torso yaw approximately35-45deg RIGHT together, chest opening/shoulders follow head; both eyes remain readable according to the race's lateral eye anatomy. Natural supported neck; no opposite chest rotation, no over-shoulder glance, no mirroring. Rightward gaze follows face. Do NOT compress muzzle/ears/horns to match human outline.
BODY STUDIES: center retain existing MALE map-front body from Image2, right retain existing MALE guarded combat-left body/pose. Apply EXACT SAME newly revised male head identity, markings, brow/jaw/horn or ear structure consistently to all3 depictions. Clothing/body unchanged. Hands correctly scaled/scaled skin or fur as current. No wrong-direction combat, no human portrait pose on map. These are static continuity studies, not animation frames.
OUTPUT:3 equal wide cells in1536x1024 transparent card. Each full figure fully inside its own cell with8% clear top/bottom and6% side margins. Portrait as complete bust, no cropped ears/crest/muzzle/shoulders. Technical export will be144x144 portrait eye~y52,48x64 map occupied56px/feet62,96x96 combat occupied88px/feet94. Strong readable silhouettes at real small size; fine detail not a substitute for racial structure. No text, logos, review guides, shadows on floor, fake alpha/checkerboard or colored matte. Only2 racial pilots will be made before owner review; do not generate the whole library.
